timestamp_treatment: HF/Massive-STEPS timestamps are naive datetimes with timezone offset stripped (no +00:00 / Z suffix). Prior temporal baselines extracted hour/weekday directly from these naive fields (= interpret-as-UTC / as-stored). Local mode: tz_localize('UTC') then tz_convert(IANA city zone).
SameWeekdayMostPop: weekday = Mon..Sun from target (last) check-in timestamp
prediction_time: target (last) check-in timestamp on the trail; never trail start
